title: Descent of etale sheaf sections along submersive morphisms with connected geometric fibres
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: One must turn equality of stalk values into equality on entire geometric fibres, using connectedness of the pulled-back constant sheaf. The saturated maximal equality locus must then descend to an open subset through submersiveness, allowing local sections to glue globally.
